links.name: Power Strike Lv. 1 Delivers a powerful blow that strikes the target with 30 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Iron Punch Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 34 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Iron Body Lv. 1 Environment-related damage is decreased by 40%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
